findings.title: A new SMTP connection for every email
findings.consequence: Without `pool: true`, nodemailer connects to the mail server, negotiates TLS and logs in for each message, then disconnects. Each email costs those round trips, and a burst of emails opens a burst of connections the mail server may throttle.
findings.fix: Create one transporter when the app starts with `pool: true` and reuse it, or send emails from a background job.

findings.title: Sessions are read from MongoDB sessions on every request with a cookie
findings.consequence: Each request that carries a session cookie reads its session document first, and writes it back (or refreshes its expiry) as the response ends. At 1,000 such requests per second that's about 2,000 session operations per second, before any real work.
findings.fix: Serve static files before the session middleware so assets skip it, and avoid rewriting unchanged sessions (connect-mongo's touchAfter, or rolling: false).
